tokens.name: --duration-micro

tokens.name: --duration-quick
tokens.usage: modal/dropdown close, text swap, tooltip appear

tokens.name: --duration-fast
tokens.usage: icon swap, dropdown/modal open, tabs sliding, page slide

tokens.name: --duration-slow
tokens.usage: panel open, skeleton content reveal, input clear

tokens.name: --duration-very-slow
tokens.usage: emphasis moments, badge appear, text reveal, success check

tokens.name: --ease-smooth-out
tokens.usage: modal/dropdown/panel open + close, page slide, resize, position change

tokens.name: --ease-in-out
tokens.usage: icon swap, text swap, text reveal, skeleton reveal

card-resize.name: Card resize
card-resize.when: Tweening a container's width or height when its layout state changes (compact ↔ expanded card, collapsing panel, list row toggling extra detail).

number-pop-in.name: Number pop-in
number-pop-in.when: Counters, prices, balances, or any number that updates and should re-enter from a direction with blur.

notification-badge.name: Notification badge
notification-badge.when: A small badge appearing on top of a trigger (bell, inbox, button).

text-states-swap.name: Text states swap
text-states-swap.when: Swapping the text of a status indicator in place: "Processing…" → "Done", "Save" → "Saved".

menu-dropdown.name: Menu dropdown
menu-dropdown.when: Contextual menus, dropdowns, popovers: anything that opens from a trigger and should visually grow from that trigger's position.

modal.name: Modal open / close
modal.when: Modal dialogs and full-overlay surfaces that scale up from center.

panel-reveal.name: Panel reveal
panel-reveal.when: A panel that slides into view inside an existing container: e.g.

page-side-by-side.name: Page side-by-side
page-side-by-side.when: Sliding between two full pages or screens that live side-by-side: list ↔ detail, step 1 ↔ step 2 in a wizard.

icon-swap.name: Icon swap
icon-swap.when: Cross-fading two icons in the same slot: hamburger ↔ close, sun ↔ moon, play ↔ pause, expand ↔ collapse.

success-check.name: Success check
success-check.when: Confirming a completed action: payment processed, file uploaded, message sent, form saved.

avatar-group-hover.name: Avatar group hover
avatar-group-hover.when: Hovering an item in a horizontal stack (avatar row, chip group, badge cluster, segmented button) should lift the hovered item, gently lift its neighbors with a power-falloff, then snap everything back with an overshoot spring on `mouseleave`.

error-state-shake.name: Error state shake
error-state-shake.when: Form validation feedback: invalid email, wrong password, missing required field, mismatched confirmation.

input-clear-dissolve.name: Input clear with dissolve
input-clear-dissolve.when: Clearing a text field: search box, filter input, any field with a clear (×) button.

skeleton-reveal.name: Skeleton loader and reveal
skeleton-reveal.when: A placeholder that loads then reveals real content: list rows, cards, profile headers.

shimmer-text.name: Shimmer text
shimmer-text.when: A loading / "thinking" label that shimmers: streaming status, "Generating…", any in-progress copy that should feel alive without a spinner.

tabs-sliding.name: Tabs sliding
tabs-sliding.when: A segmented control / tab bar where the active pill slides between options: view switchers, filter segments, small mutually-exclusive button sets.

tooltip.name: Tooltip open/close
tooltip.when: A hover/focus tooltip shared by a group of triggers (toolbar buttons, icon rows, avatar stacks).

texts-reveal.name: Texts reveal
texts-reveal.when: A headline + supporting line that rise into view with staggered blur: hero copy, empty states, onboarding steps.

card-tilt.name: Card hover tilt
card-tilt.when: A card / tile / media surface that tilts in 3D toward the pointer while hovered, with a soft light "glare" tracking the cursor across it.

plus-menu-morph.name: Plus to menu morph
plus-menu-morph.when: A small circular trigger (a "+" FAB, a compose button, an add-action affordance) that morphs into the menu / panel it opens instead of popping a separate surface next to it.

accordion.name: Accordion expand
accordion.when: A disclosure / accordion / collapsible section whose panel grows and shrinks in height when toggled, with the header chevron flipping between a downward "v" and an upward "^".

toast.name: Toast open / close
toast.when: Toasts, snackbars, and transient confirmations that rise into view from the bottom edge: "Saved", "Copied", "Message sent".

like-button.name: Like button
like-button.when: Like / favorite / heart buttons: anywhere a single tap flips a boolean and deserves a tiny celebration.

learn-more-hover.name: Learn more hover
learn-more-hover.when: "Learn more", "See all", "Continue": inline links or buttons with a trailing chevron that should acknowledge hover.

checkbox-check.name: Checkbox check
checkbox-check.when: Checkboxes, to-do completion, multi-select rows: any boolean control where the checked state should feel earned.

spinning-counter.name: Spinning counter
spinning-counter.when: Numbers that change with fanfare: points, prices, follower counts, dashboards KPIs.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.when: On/off switches: settings rows, theme toggles, feature flags.

thinking-states.name: Thinking states
thinking-states.when: An AI status line that narrates what the agent is doing: "Setting up a workplace", "Running a command", "Browsing files".

reasoning-stream.name: Reasoning stream
reasoning-stream.when: An agent "thinking out loud": a small card plays back a stream of reasoning by stepping the transcript up two lines at a time, holding between steps.

streaming-text.name: Streaming text
streaming-text.when: Model output arriving word by word: chat responses, AI completions, any streamed paragraph.

matrix-loader.name: Matrix dot loader
matrix-loader.when: Tiny inline loaders built from a 4×4 matrix of 2px dots.
